query: SELECT DISTINCT npc_response_collection.root_sequence_id FROM npc_response_collection              WHERE npc_response_collection.state IN ('collecting', 'selected', 'executing') AND (                  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM npc_candidate                          JOIN invocation ON invocation.id = npc_candidate.decision_invocation_id                          WHERE npc_candidate.collection_id = npc_response_collection.id AND invocation.outcome = 'interrupted')                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM npc_candidate                             JOIN sequence ON sequence.id = npc_candidate.execution_sequence_id                             WHERE npc_candidate.collection_id = npc_response_collection.id AND sequence.error = ?1)                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM npc_response_source                             JOIN message ON message.id = npc_response_source.message_id                             LEFT JOIN inference ON inference.id = message.source_inference_id                             JOIN sequence ON sequence.id = COALESCE(message.trigger_sequence_id, inference.sequence_id)                             WHERE npc_response_source.collection_id = npc_response_collection.id AND sequence.error = ?1))
